Every column position is printed 'C1F1' or 'C2F1' (column mark + footing mark). F1 is the only footing mark: 18 positions = 12 C1 (rows A and D, grids 1-6) + 6 C2 (rows B and C on grids 1, 5 and 6).
No grid bubbles are printed; grid labels 1-6 / A-D were assigned in the grid master.
